links.source_location: rationale: Waycast routers replaced raw WebSockets for structured real-time bidirectional communication between Manager and Worker nodes
rationale: BGP is not fully implemented in the evaluator engine yet, requiring extension of @vlab/evaluator to support BGP peerings, route advertisements, and AS configurations
rationale: evaluator system dictates the grading of student labs, critical to test correctness especially with BGP and CLI checks added
rationale: worker previously sent placeholder/mocked metrics (storageMb: 100000, Math.random() CPU/memory), needed replacement with actual system telemetry
rationale: as more complex evaluation capabilities (BGP, CLI commands, file checks) are added, an intuitive UI is needed for instructors to configure checks without raw JSON/code
